scope: Historical methods and reported outcomes are context only; no historical numerical bound, column, dual, pricing result, or point is used in Source18r certification.

PR147.head: 31858f4e35b44caadeee2a72ef2ae2d35b74899b
PR147.title: Certify original M1 arc-LP floor and bounded D-W threshold CG
mathematics: Legacy frozen FULL arc-LP retains all original matrix rows, bounds, objective, and fixed inputs while relaxing all 208312 binary variables to continuous.
Terminal OPTIMAL LP and independent exact-rational weak-duality support certificate verify a legacy original arc-LP floor.
Legacy PR143 projected feasible-set inclusion transfers the certified arc-LP floor to the same complete D-W root.
A separate restricted D-W master continuation uses columns, stabilized discovery prices, current true master duals, and four integer pricing subproblems.

PR203.head: 1535584eaea7162931642878a6a9728b4988bb6f
PR203.title: Reuse legacy CG mechanics in bounded M-stage trajectory DW research
mathematics: Complete 96-slot integer vehicle domains are represented by trajectory columns and four convexity equalities.
Every original mixed coupling and nonunit grid row stays in the D-W master; finite restricted-master objective has no Global LB authority.
Current original-row dual multipliers define q_m = c_m - B_m^T y; the certificate also includes the exact nonunit-variable minimum.
Integer pricing trajectories are searched by full96 MILP, while independent binary-partition LP-dual covers certify all missing trajectories.
Discovery stabilization cannot certify bounds; columns, native BestBound, pricing incumbents, and RMP objective are not standalone certificate authorities in that method.
evidence: PR203 body retrieved via gh pr view

current_pilot_difference: Uses Source18r original FULL line_thermal_face coefficients, RHS, exact affine auxiliary definitions, and current fixed B2 May01 inputs.
One nonnegative convex line/time/facet weight vector yields rho_max >= sum_k w_k b_k + sum_m (sum_k w_k a_km)^T x_m.
Eliminates selected exact affine grid response/injection expressions; no grid or nonunit D-W master remains.
Solves four sequential full96 integer vehicle support subproblems with no route fractionation.
Global certificate follows original feasible-point projection into the product of vehicle relaxations and sums independently verified support lower bounds.
Cross-vehicle coupling constraints are omitted rather than copied into each vehicle model.
No column generation, pricing iteration, master dual optimization, dual stabilization, branch-and-price, or Full MILP native call.
